units.source_text: 匂亲王对京中人说出外避凶两天，故在这期间可与浮舟从容欢聚，两人的情爱就越来越深。

en.t: Prince Niou told the people in the capital that he would be away for two days to avoid misfortune, and during that time he was able to spend unhurried hours with Ukifune, so their love grew ever deeper.

units.source_text: 右近留守山庄，照例捏造借口，替浮舟送衣服去。

en.t: Ukon stayed behind at the mountain villa and, as usual, made up an excuse to send clothes to Ukifune.

units.source_text: 浮舟今天把寝乱的头发稍加整饰，换上了深紫色和红梅色的衣服，色彩配合非常调和。

en.t: Today Ukifune lightly arranged her sleep-tousled hair and changed into garments of deep purple and red plum, the colors harmonizing beautifully.

units.source_text: 侍从也脱去原来的旧衣，换一件华丽的新上装。

en.t: The attendant also took off her old clothes and changed into a splendid new outer robe.

units.source_text: 匂亲王戏把这新上装给浮舟穿上，叫她捧盥洗盆。

en.t: In play, Prince Niou put this new outer robe on Ukifune and had her hold the wash basin.

units.source_text: 他想：“把此人送给大公主当侍女，大公主定然宠爱她。

en.t: He thought, If I sent this girl to serve the eldest princess as an attendant, the princess would surely cherish her.

units.source_text: 大公主身边虽有许多出身高贵的侍女，但相貌如此漂亮的恐怕没有吧。”

en.t: Although the eldest princess has many attendants of noble birth around her, there is probably no one as beautiful as this.

units.source_text: 这一天两人任情做种种游戏，有的不堪入目。

en.t: That day the two gave themselves over to all kinds of games, some of them unfit to be seen.

units.source_text: 匂亲王再三地对浮舟说，要秘密带她到京中去隐匿。

en.t: Prince Niou repeatedly told Ukifune that he wanted to take her secretly to the capital and hide her there.

units.source_text: 并且要她对天立誓：“在这期间决不和薰大将相见。”

en.t: He also wanted her to swear to heaven that during this time she would never meet Captain Kaoru.

units.source_text: 浮舟非常困窘，一句话也不能回答，甚至流下泪来。

en.t: Ukifune was terribly distressed and could not answer a single word; she even began to weep.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看到这模样，想道：“她在我面前，尚且不能忘怀那人！”不胜伤心。

en.t: Seeing her like this, Prince Niou thought, Even in front of me she still cannot forget that man, and he was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 这一晚他有时诉恨，有时哭泣，直到天明。

en.t: That night he sometimes poured out his resentment and sometimes wept, continuing until dawn.

units.source_text: 天色尚未亮足之时，他带了浮舟回对岸山庄，与来时一样，亲自抱她上船，对她说道：“你所关怀的那个人，对你总不会如此亲切吧！

en.t: Before the sky was fully light, he took Ukifune back to the villa on the opposite bank, and just as when they had come, he personally carried her onto the boat and said to her, The man you care about would never be this tender to you, would he?
Do you understand my true feelings now?

units.source_text: 浮舟想来的确如此，对他点点头，匂亲王觉得她非常可爱。

en.t: When Ukifune thought about it, she felt that this was indeed so and nodded to him, and Prince Niou found her very dear.

units.source_text: 右近开了边门，放他们进来。

en.t: Ukon opened the side gate and let them in.

units.source_text: 匂亲王就此告别而去，心中犹未餍足。

en.t: Prince Niou then took his leave and went away, though his heart was still not satisfied.
